verdict.rationale: Canva's docs confirm multi-format export (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) and dimension/aspect-ratio resizing via the Connect API/MCP tools, but there is no evidence of SVG export, per-layer export controls, or asset 'slices' as used in dedicated design tools. Missing for 10: SVG export support, per-layer export presets, slice/artboard-based export, and any independent hands-on confirmation of export fidelity.
